name: Verina (Verifiable Code Generation Arena)
description: Verina is a benchmark for verifiable code generation that evaluates code, specification, and proof generation along with their compositions. It contains 189 manually curated coding tasks in Lean with detailed problem descriptions, reference implementations, formal specifications, and test suites.
reputation: Verina is a recent specialized benchmark for verifiable code generation in Lean, with growing interest but limited broad adoption so far.
notes: Provides a holistic evaluation framework for verifiable code generation including proofs; highlights challenges in proof generation.
